categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Matches the Build system label and updates CI workflow configurations alongside supported macOS toolchain requirements.
categories.rationale: Retires end-of-life macOS 14 toolchain support to modernize developer toolchains and unblock future C++ standards. The author notes macOS 14 reached EOL in August 2026, and bumping CLT to 26.3 provides an LLVM-19 equivalent toolchain that 'will allow to use C++20 CTAD and also allow switching the project to C++23.' (PR description).

categories.name: docs
categories.evidence: Documentation and release note modifications merely follow from the build toolchain version bump.
categories.rationale: Doc updates are secondary edits documenting the toolchain requirement change and do not constitute a standalone documentation change.
